description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with computer hardware, software and applications, computer communications, and other aspects of the basic theory , who are expertise in computer research and application development, computer teaching, computer communications network engineering design and development, operational management and maintenance in the units such as scientific research, education, the executive departments, the information industry and government. The major is a brand field of the university. It is making great efforts to take talents training as the basis, and sound systems as the foundation, by constantly innovating. It is trying to form interdisciplinary, giving full play to the advantage of communication of the university.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
